name: Krisp
description: Krisp lets agents search and read meeting transcripts, summaries, action items, and upcoming meetings in the signed-in Krisp account. Each user signs in to their own Krisp account through the browser.

prompts.text: List the action items from my meetings this week.
Summarize yesterday's call with the design team.
What meetings do I have tomorrow, and what did we discuss last time with each group?

apps.name: Krisp
apps.description: Meeting transcripts, summaries, and action items, over Krisp's MCP server with browser sign-in.
